name: OHIARequestedServiceTypeCDT
title: OHIA Requested Service Type (PAS service types plus CDT)
description: Every code in the Da Vinci PAS 2.2.1 X12 278 Requested Service Type value set, PLUS the ADA CDT code system (http://www.ada.org/cdt), so that an oral prior authorization can carry its CDT procedure code. The CDT codes are ADA-licensed and are NOT enumerated here: the whole code system is included by reference.
